{"code": "import numpy as np

# Convert revenue to float, handling thousands separators
# Replace commas in revenue and convert to float
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for the QA orders (which should be 6)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Filter to only converted customers
converted_customers = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Check for refunded orders among converted customers
refunded_converted = converted_customers[converted_customers['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f'Number of converted but refunded orders: {len(refunded_converted)}')

# Drop QA orders and refunded orders
# We assume QA orders are not real, and refunded orders don't count as real conversions
valid_converted = converted_customers[
    (converted_customers['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99) &
    (converted_customers['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Now compute mean age of valid converted customers
mean_age_converted = valid_converted['customer_age'].mean()

mean_age_converted"}
